verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS planning platform like Pigment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Data residency, audit trail, SSO and access-rights evidence are adjacent privacy and security features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
